title_zh: 更正虚构案件表格中的行为人及处罚栏

scenario.label_zh: 区分虚构案例中的违法行为和处罚
scenario.goal_zh: 根据美国英语课堂案例更正表格，把违法行为、行为人和处罚分别列入正确栏

context_zh: 美国英语课堂使用虚构案件练习阅读，不讨论现实法律适用。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: I put 'shoplifting' in the offender column. Is that right?

sentences.speaker: Ms Carter
sentences.text: No. The offender is the person who committed the offense. In this case, that person is Alex.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: So shoplifting belongs under 'offense', and Alex belongs under 'offender'.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carter
sentences.text: Exactly. What penalty does this fictional case say the court imposed?

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: A fine. I'll put that in the last column, not the person's name.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carter
sentences.text: Good. Keep your answer to the facts given in the case.
